description: UK (England, Scotland, Wales): child maintenance as the Child Maintenance Service works it out: 12%, 16% or 19% of gross income (less above £800 a week), other children, shared care nights, the £7 flat and reduced rates.

annualIncome.description: Paying parent gross income a year before tax, GBP

benefits.description: Paying parent gets a qualifying benefit (flat rate)

children.description: Children this calculation is for (3 means 3 or more)

nights.description: Nights a year the children stay with the paying parent

otherChildren.description: Other children the paying parent supports, 0-3

pension.description: Pension contributions a year, GBP (taken off first)
